assertion: Thailand bought $1.34 billion in U.S. agricultural products in 2025
The U.S. exported $19.6 billion in products to Thailand in 2025 while importing $91.3 billion in products. ... imports from the country rose 45% that year alone
sql: SELECT year, SUM(value_usd) FROM econ.trade_imports WHERE geo_level='country' AND country_name ILIKE 'Thailand' GROUP BY year

assertion: Thailand has been a steady, consistent market with sales peaking at $1.69 billion in 2021.
inaccuracy: The claim says the peak was 2021 at $1.69B; only DTN states this, and Census HS 01-24 in the warehouse peaks in 2018 ($1.76B) on a narrower definition
measure: US agricultural exports to Thailand by year

assertion: A White House fact sheet released with the October 2025 framework had put that figure at 99%
independent_value: DTN and Investing.com confirm October 2025 framework with 99% tariff removal

assertion: Trump also said Thailand had agreed to eliminate tariffs on US exports and remove significant barriers to American products including vehicles, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, ethanol and poultry. He also cited about $2.6 billion in additional purchases of US agricultural products.
speaker: Donald Trump
inaccuracy: Trump says tariffs were eliminated; Thailand's Commerce Minister said Thailand had not abolished tariffs on all US goods and 99% remains under negotiation; the Nation reports $2.6B as annual purchases and the signed document was a joint statement
independent_value: Thai Commerce Minister Suphajee: tariffs not abolished on all US goods (Nation Thailand, Nov 19 2026)
why_not: The DTN passage matches that Trump said it; the grade is on whether the statements are accurate, which Thai officials dispute.
measure: US agricultural exports to Thailand by country

assertion: Thailand Trade Deal Will Include $2.6 Billion in US Ag Purchases, Pork Market Access, Trump Says
inaccuracy: The headline says the deal will include these terms; the evidence says the signed document was a joint statement with unpublished terms and Thai officials dispute the tariff and pork parts
measure: US agricultural exports to Thailand by country
independent_value: Joint statement, not final agreement; terms unpublished (DTN, Investing.com, Nation)
